name: Tokkou-chan
source: A Tokkouchan type monster girl. Tokkouchan type monster girls appear to be fighting miko. This Tokkouchan has a very dangerous attack that can incapacitate an enemy with one strike making her very difficult to beat. She doesn't attack [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] out of malice but for the sake of her honor as a warrior.
